title: She Came Back Different

content:
"She loved him completely. He used that love like a weapon." Mara Ashford was the kind of woman who believed in second chances in people, in love, in the goodness buried underneath broken things. She gave everything she had to Damien Cross: her loyalty, her secrets, her future. And the night he decided she was no longer useful, he took all of it. They found her at the edge of the city, left for dead, stripped of everything except the fury building quietly in her bones. She never came back. Something else did. Two years later, a woman walks into Damien's world wearing a stranger's name and a smile that doesn't quite reach her eyes. She is polished. Untouchable. Fluent in every language power speaks. And something about her makes the hair on the back of his neck stand up, something he can't explain, can't shake, can't stop thinking about at 3 AM when the city goes quiet. He doesn't recognize her. But he wants her. Desperately. Dangerously. He has no idea he already destroyed her once. She came back to take everything. He's about to fall in love with his own undoing.
